payload.title: LinkedIn real connect and spike (#5)
payload.objective: Prove the LinkedIn adapter against the live API: one real connect and the spike script, then replace the hand-written fixtures with recorded ones.
successCriteria: A self-serve LinkedIn app with Share on LinkedIn and Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect connects a profile
The spike publishes and deletes a text post and a link post
What the token answer lists as scope, the permalink form and the character limit are recorded in docs/platform-notes/linkedin.md
Fixtures are replaced by recorded answers
Thumbnail for link posts is built or explicitly deferred to the media model
